24s.name: 24S
24s.description:
**24S** is owned by **LVMH**.

Bernard Arnault, the chairman and **CEO** of **LMVH** Moet Hennessy-Louis Vuitton, and the world's richest man according to Forbes, has **invested** in cybersecurity firm, **Wiz**, the **Israeli** maker of cloud security solutions for enterprises.[^1]

[^1]: https://www.timesofisrael.com/luxury-goods-magnate-bernard-arnault-invests-in-israeli-cybersecurity-firm-wiz/

dove.name: Dove
dove.description:
Owned by **Unilever**.

**Persil** and Ben & Jerry's are owned by **Unilever**. When Ben & Jerry's decided to stop selling its products in Israel, **Unilever** sold off the Israeli distribution rights to Avi Zinger to circumvent their decision and to force Ben & Jerry's brand name to continue selling in Israel.[^1]

[^1]: https://www.unilever.com/news/press-and-media/press-releases/2022/unilever-reaches-new-business-arrangement-for-ben-jerrys-in-israel/

dovemars.name: Dove (Mars)
dovemars.description:
Owned by **Mars Inc**.

**Mars** will support Israeli start-ups and the formation of companies, and will work together with leading Israeli academic institutions, such as the Hebrew University, the Weizmann Institute, the Technion, Migall and Tel Hai College, among others, to further Foodtech innovations.[^1]

[^1]: https://www.foodmanufacturing.com/home/news/13251464/mars-incorporated-partners-with-jerusalem-venture-partners-to-foster-foodtech-solutions-in-israel

nestle.description:
Osem is an israeli food manufacturer which operates in Occupied Palestine. Nestle owns a controlling stake in Osem.[^1]

Avoid Nestle products until they divest all operations in Occupied Palestine.
Especially avoid any Osem brands such as Sabra Salads and others which can be found via the wikipedia page in the source.
[^1]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Osem_(company)

For water, look for Saka or non-Nestle/Coca-Cola/Pepsico brands

lorealloreal.description:

Don't buy L'Oreal products
Don't sell L'Oreal products
Don't work for L'Oreal Groupe
[^1]: https://bdsmovement.net/news/l%E2%80%99oreal-makeup-israeli-apartheid
